seo.title: Akhtar Shaikh — Frontend & AI Automation Developer
seo.description: React and React Native developer building full-stack products and local-LLM automation. Based in India, open to remote roles and freelance work.

hero.title: Frontend & AI Automation Developer
hero.pitch: I ship React and React Native products end to end — Node APIs, Docker, AWS — and build local-LLM agents that take repetitive work off people's plates.

about.text: I've shipped web and mobile products since 2019 — freelance first, then React Native at Subtle Solution, and since 2021 full stack at Just Logic Software. I care about clean frontend architecture, dependable API integrations and reproducible Docker deployments. After hours, I build offline AI workspaces and multi-agent systems on Ollama, OpenRouter and Hermes.

projects.title: Offline AI Development Workspace
projects.description: A portable, fully offline AI platform: browser dashboard for code, terminal and AI assistance. Local inference via Ollama with resource-aware model selection, persistent memory, multi-user profiles — runs on Windows, Linux and macOS straight from external storage.

projects.title: AI Agent & Business Automation Platform
projects.description: Manager–worker multi-agent system for coding help, research, support and operations. Agents live on Discord, Telegram and the web with persistent sessions, switchable local or cloud LLMs, and Dockerised services on a VPS.

projects.title: Containerised Deployment Environments
projects.description: Reusable Docker images and Compose setups that standardise local and production multi-service environments across client projects.
